problems.problem: Direct email inquiries initiated by clicking the website's email link are routed to '[redacted]' (a probable typo for the former 'izzysservice.com' domain) rather than '[redacted]', creating an immediate risk of bounced or lost customer leads.
problems.label: fact
problems.basis: Observed directly on https://www.cornerstonecomfort.net/ and all subpages: the mailto link is '[redacted]', while the visible text is '[redacted]' and the Meta embed domain is 'izzysservice.com'.

problems.problem: Lead and booking intake is split across Wix native forms (quote requests, general contact, Comfort Club signups), an Instant Estimate tool, and external book.housecallpro.com links.
problems.label: inference
problems.basis: Inferred from the presence of Wix form-app scripts and forms alongside book.housecallpro.com references and the /instant-estimate page.

problems.problem: Leads submitted through Wix forms ('Get a Price Quote', 'Let’s Talk Comfort', 'Join the Comfort Club Today') and the Instant Estimate tool may not automatically sync into their field-service software within two minutes, potentially causing manual data entry overhead or delayed follow-up on high-value installation estimates.
problems.label: hypothesis
problems.basis: Wix forms and custom instant estimators typically send email notifications to a shared inbox unless custom webhook/API automation is configured to push leads into field-service software.

problems.problem: With active paid advertising on Google Ads (AW-11223296975) and Meta (connect.facebook.net) driving traffic across multiple conversion paths, the owners may lack a single weekly report connecting ad spend by channel to actual booked jobs and closed revenue.
problems.label: hypothesis
problems.basis: Small home-service contractors using Wix and field-service software rarely have automated attribution tying Google and Meta ad spend to closed job revenue in their field-service and accounting systems.

existingSolutions.addresses: Fixes the '[redacted]' typo in the clickable email links across the website header/footer so emails go to '[redacted]'.

existingSolutions.solution: Native online booking and lead capture widgets from their existing field-service software (book.housecallpro.com)
existingSolutions.addresses: Replacing or connecting Wix native quote forms with native field-service lead forms so web inquiries land directly in the dispatch/CRM system without custom middleware.
Sends basic automated confirmation emails when a visitor submits a Wix form ('Get a Price Quote' or 'Join the Comfort Club Today').

forgexSolutions.name: Revenue Leak Check
forgexSolutions.description: One-week audit ($500 fixed price, credited in full toward any fix ordered within 30 days) examining how many calls, Wix form submissions, Instant Estimate completions, and misrouted emails slip through without a booked job, and quantifying their revenue value.
forgexSolutions.problem: Fragmented lead intake across Wix forms, Instant Estimate, phone calls, and the misconfigured mailto link while spending on Google and Meta ads.
forgexSolutions.whyNotExistingSoftware: Existing software platforms (Wix, Google Ads, and field-service software) each track only their own silo and do not audit cross-channel lead drop-off, unfollowed instant estimates, or broken contact links.

forgexSolutions.name: Lead-to-job pipeline
forgexSolutions.description: Automated pipeline ($1,800 setup plus $149/month) ensuring every lead from Wix quote forms, Comfort Club signup forms, and the Instant Estimate tool lands directly in their field-service software within two minutes, triggers an immediate personalized reply, and creates a tracked follow-up task so no estimate or inquiry goes uncalled.
forgexSolutions.problem: Potential manual re-entry or slow follow-up on Wix form submissions and 60-second Instant Estimate leads that require an in-home evaluation to close.
forgexSolutions.whyNotExistingSoftware: While their booking software handles direct appointment slots, custom multi-step flows like the Instant Estimate tool and Comfort Club plan selection forms on Wix do not natively create structured customer records, estimates, and automated follow-up sequences inside field-service software without custom integration.

forgexSolutions.name: Owner's Monday numbers
forgexSolutions.description: Weekly one-page summary ($1,200 setup plus $99/month) delivered every Monday showing booked revenue, close rate, average ticket, cost per booked job by lead source, and accounts receivable across their field-service software, accounting software, and Google/Meta ad accounts.
forgexSolutions.problem: Lack of unified visibility into return on ad spend across Google Ads, Meta Ads, Instant Estimate leads, and completed field jobs.
forgexSolutions.whyNotExistingSoftware: Native dashboards in Wix, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and field-service software do not combine ad spend and accounting receivables with closed job data into a single source-attributed owner report.

feasibility.explanation: Wix forms and webhook triggers, Google/Meta ad reporting APIs, and standard field-service management APIs/webhooks are well-documented and straightforward to integrate using standard automation workflows.

aiDelivery.explanation: Deterministic workflow automation (webhooks, API integrations, and SQL/data aggregation) should handle lead routing, CRM record creation, and Monday financial reporting for reliability, while AI agents can assist in drafting personalized follow-up messages based on the homeowner's Instant Estimate selections or triaging free-text form inquiries.

humanReview: Owner or office manager review before sending any non-standard pricing or custom technical responses to homeowners.
In-home technician evaluation and human approval are explicitly required before issuing a final fixed installation price following an online Instant Estimate.
Human verification of Comfort Club recurring billing setup and plan eligibility before charging a customer.

risks.description: Automated SMS or email replies triggered by Wix forms or the Instant Estimate tool must comply with TCPA and CAN-SPAM consent rules, ensuring opt-in language on Wix forms covers automated follow-up.

Ongoing rebranding from Izzy’s Service to Cornerstone Comfort creates a risk of inconsistent sender names, domains, or duplicate customer records if legacy and new domains are not normalized during integration.

Customer PII (names, home addresses, phone numbers, and equipment details) transmitted between Wix forms and field-service software must be encrypted in transit and stored with least-privilege API credentials.

commercial.value: Illustrative gross revenue impact of $5,760/year from converting 2 additional Gold Comfort Club memberships per month (24/year × $240/year published price), plus an illustrative $9,800/year from recovering 1 additional standard hot water heater replacement per quarter (4/year × $2,450 published special price), or $21,996/year if recovering 1 tankless water heater installation per quarter (4/year × $5,499 published special price).

Assumes fixing misrouted email links and automating sub-2-minute lead follow-up across Wix forms and the Instant Estimate tool recovers an illustrative 2 Gold Comfort Club plans per month (24/year) and 1 hot water heater or tankless water heater installation per quarter (4/year).
Figures represent illustrative gross revenue based on published site prices, not net profit or guaranteed results.

discovery.outreachSubject: Quick heads-up on a broken email link on cornerstonecomfort.net + lead routing question
discovery.outreachBody:
Hi [redacted],

I was looking through Cornerstone Comfort's website and noticed a quick technical issue from the rebrand from Izzy's Service: while your page text lists [redacted], the clickable email link across the site actually points to [redacted] (spelled with a "y"). Anyone clicking that link to email you is likely getting a bounce.

I also noticed you're running Google and Meta ads while capturing leads across several different places—your 60-second Instant Estimate tool, Wix quote and Comfort Club forms, and online scheduling.

I run ForgeX ([ForgeX Website Placeholder]), where we help family-owned HVAC and plumbing contractors connect their web forms, instant estimators, and ad accounts directly into their field-service software. Before recommending any software work, we offer a fixed-price Revenue Leak Check ($500) that audits how many calls, form leads, and instant estimates slip through the cracks over one week—and the $500 is credited in full if you decide to have us build a fix within 30 days. We don't promise specific revenue results, and sometimes the best answer is a simple tweak to the tools you already own.

Would you be open to a brief 10-minute call next week to see if your Instant Estimate and Wix form leads are syncing cleanly into your dispatch system?

Best regards,

[Founder Name]
[Founder Title], ForgeX
[Founder Phone Number]
[ForgeX Street Address, City, State, ZIP]

If you prefer not to receive future emails from me, simply reply with "unsubscribe" or "opt out" and I will remove you immediately.

qualification.rationale: Cornerstone Comfort is an owner-led residential HVAC and water contractor in Nampa, Idaho (founded in 2011 by [redacted], with 500+ five-star reviews) that actively pays for leads via Google Ads (AW-11223296975) and Meta Ads. Publicly observable facts on the website point directly to lead-capture and routing issues that ForgeX's Revenue Leak Check and Lead-to-job pipeline address: (1) a broken/misspelled clickable email link ('[redacted]') across all pages during their rebrand from Izzy's Service to Cornerstone Comfort, and (2) fragmented lead intake split across multiple native Wix forms ('Get a Price Quote', 'Let’s Talk Comfort', 'Join the Comfort Club Today'), a 60-second Instant Estimate tool requiring follow-up for in-home evaluation, and external book.housecallpro.com scheduling links. A verified business contact channel ([redacted]) and named owner decision-makers exist, making this a strong candidate for immediate outreach while verifying team headcount during discovery.
